output.businessUnderstanding: The pipeline correctly understood that U-Proof is a South African waterproofing/building-products manufacturer (owner Martin) whose WooCommerce ecommerce site is being rebuilt/completed by Creative Touch after a prior developer relationship ended without handover. It correctly captured that the client likes the existing design and wants completion/improvement rather than a redesign, that real VAT-inclusive ZAR retail pricing was supplied and must be used exactly (Liquid Rubber, Fibre Filler, Wall & Roof Paint, Zinc Phosphate Primer, Bonding Liquid Primer, Plaster Primer, Membrane), and that the client wants live Fastway Courier shipping rates plus Payflex BNPL/card payment rather than manual EFT or flat-rate shipping as the primary checkout path. It also correctly treated this as a non-blind run, cross-referencing Creative Touch's own prior 2026-09-02 technical audit rather than starting fresh.
audienceInferred: South African contractors purchasing waterproofing materials for commercial/residential jobs
DIY homebuilders sealing roofs, walls, foundations and cracks
Architects/specifiers needing technical validation before specifying products
Trade buyers seeking bulk/technical pricing via phone contact
output.conversionModelInferred: Primary model is direct ecommerce purchase through WooCommerce: browse by category or application use-case -> view accurate size/variant pricing (5L/20L, membrane widths) -> add to cart -> checkout with live Fastway Courier shipping rate calculation -> pay via Paystack card or Payflex BNPL (explicitly avoiding EFT/manual/COD as primary). A secondary, lower-volume conversion path is trade/technical lead generation via phone or contact form for architects and bulk buyers.
